answer.reason: Both are fee-earning alternative and real estate investment managers. RMR is a CRE-focused manager. It runs property and asset management, capital formation and development for its managed real estate companies and investors. Ares is a diversified alternative manager, and real estate is only one of its strategies, next to credit, private equity, infrastructure and secondaries. The real estate equity and debt business overlaps with RMR, and so does the manager model. But Ares's core is multi-strategy fund management for institutional and wealth investors. RMR also does hands-on property management and serves externally managed REITs. So the overlap is partial in both products and customers.

T:P1.1.text: RMR Group | Leading U.S. CRE Investment Manager

T:P1.2.text: For 40 years, RMR has combined institutional discipline with entrepreneurial agility to unlock opportunity across all major real estate sectors.

T:P1.3.text: How Sun Belt renters are navigating choice, technology and uncertainty

T:P1.4.text: Industrial Demand in the Data Center Economy

T:P1.5.text: Industrial assets adjacent to data center corridors are showing stronger fundamentals, stickier tenants and longer economic lives than the broader market - and they capture that upside without ever becoming data centers themselves.

T:P1.6.text: Defining the Collateral Advantage in Private CRE Credit

T:P1.7.text: Tom Lorenzini and Jared Lewis discuss how private CRE credit offers distinct collateral advantages and downside protection.

T:P1.8.text: Potential isn’t patient. It unfolds where strategy and execution meet.

T:P1.9.text: For nearly four decades, we’ve operated at the intersection of insight and execution: identifying opportunity early, acting with precision and delivering results through cycles. We combine the scale of an institutional platform with the agility of an operator, partnering closely with investors, tenants and stakeholders to create long-term value. Our diversified model spans property management, asset management, capital formation, development and strategic operations, designed to anticipate market needs and respond decisively. T:P1.10.text: We don’t just react to the market. We anticipate it. Through data, experience and instinct, we identify opportunity before it’s obvious. Explore some of our projects currently in motion.

T:P1.11.text: Master plan of eclectic new neighborhood spanning 18 acres designed to transform Nashville's East Bank and connect to Downtown.

T:P1.12.text: Located just one mile from the University of North Carolina Wilmington, the 8.6‑acre, shovel‑ready site will be transformed from a vacant AMC theater into a fully amenitized, modern housing option designed to meet strong and growing demand from upperclassmen and graduate students.

T:P1.13.text: High-impact repositioning in the heart of Foggy Bottom.

T:P1.14.text: Delivering a modern residential community paired with ground‑floor retail; expanding an already successful adaptive‑reuse campus into a vibrant mixed‑use destination.

T:P1.15.text: North Station Gateway: Landmark Mixed-Use Development

T:P1.16.text: Designed to serve as a true gateway between downtown Boston and its northern neighborhoods, the North Station Gateway project will introduce new residential, hospitality and retail offerings to one of the city’s most dynamic and rapidly evolving districts.

T:P1.18.text: Transforming an obsolete office park into a vibrant, transit-oriented multifamily community.

T:P1.19.text: The best partnerships don’t just manage capital. They create new chapters of growth.

T:P1.20.text: We believe the strongest partnerships aren’t transactional. They’re transformational. That’s why we invest alongside our clients, share their risk and work relentlessly to make them look brilliant. With the scale of a national platform and the service culture of a boutique firm, we turn partnership into a lasting strategic advantage.

C:S1.1.text: The Ares Real Estate Group's equity team focuses on value-add and opportunistic investing, while the Real Estate Group's debt team focuses on directly originated commercial mortgage investments across the risk spectrum.

C:S2.1.text: The firm runs credit, real estate, private equity, infrastructure, and secondaries.

C:S3.1.text: Credit covers direct lending, private high yield, mezzanine, and structured credit.

C:S4.1.text: Ares serves institutional investors, and the firm has also expanded into retail-accessible vehicles through its wealth distribution arm, which works with registered investment advisors, broker-dealers, and private wealth managers.

C:S5.1.text: Real estate and infrastructure are grouped in one unit that includes real estate equity and debt, as well as infrastructure equity and debt, including logistics, data centers, and energy transition assets globally.

C:S6.1.text: The private equity arm pursues control or shared-control investments in middle-market and growth-stage companies across North America and Europe.
